title: Artifact Viewers and Editors per Subset
description: Replace the general app system with a specific one: every artifact subset owns a viewer (read-only) and an editor, both shaped like today's apps (🎭️modes/<mode>/🪟️windows/<window>/ with 🦀️component.rs + 🟦️component.ts leaves) and living beside the subset's 🧬️schema/🚪️io/📚️examples at 🗿️artifacts/<kind>/🏅️standards/🔖️<v>/🪆️subsets/<subset>/👁️viewer and /✏️editor. Plugins may register viewers/editors for subsets they do not own by mirroring the owner's path under their own 🗿️artifacts (marked x-semio.contribution, runtime via .depends_on + contribution router). The user can open any artifact in any registered viewer/editor ("Open with…") and configure per-subset defaults, persisted event-sourced in the OS 🎚️config lane (OpeningPreferences, set-default-app/clear-default-app mutations). SDK splits ArtifactApp into ArtifactEditor and a new ArtifactViewer whose ViewEmit makes artifact mutations unrepresentable; VcsArtifactApp enforces read-only at runtime. Hosts gain an AppRouter + OpeningResolver in Rust (wasmtime) and TypeScript (browser) parity; both shells (React + wgpu) get role-aware sessions, read-only chrome, Open with… and a Default apps settings tab, en/de. 🎛️apps is dissolved repo-wide; 🔣️taxonomy.json gains surface vocabulary (👁️viewer/✏️editor/surface*) and retires app* keys, with all three validators (root 📜️script.ts policies, 📇️registry/📜️script.ts, Rust taxonomy gate) taught the new shape and .vscode/launch.json regenerated. Master plan: 📋️master-plan.md in this ticket folder.
summary:
Replaced the general app system with per-artifact-subset surfaces: all 143 owned subsets now carry a viewer (read-only) and an editor, each shaped modes/<mode>/windows/<window>/ with both component.rs and component.ts leaves — 286 surfaces, 7652 files, all 33 apps dirs gone, zero scaffold residue. Landed AppRole/AppRef and the canonical surface id <kind>@<standard>/<subset>#<role>; split ArtifactApp into ArtifactEditor and a new ArtifactViewer whose ViewEmit makes artifact/draft mutations structurally unrepresentable, backed by a VcsArtifactApp guard rejecting the eight mutating verbs as viewer.read-only with a Rights::Read-only store attach, plus seven frozen window kits; AppRouter + OpeningResolver in both the Rust wasmtime and TS browser hosts with five OS commands on channel tags 27/28/29 and shared golden vectors; OpeningPreferences in the OS config lane as a fold over the config op log (event-sourced, no CRUD/CRDT); role-aware sessions, read-only chrome, Open with… and a Default apps settings tab in both shells, en+de; taxonomy schemaVersion 5 with surface vocabulary added first and app* keys deleted only after the last apps dir was gone, four new policies, and a permanent taxonomy-derived `new surface` scaffolder. Gates: semio-framework-plugin 214 pass / 6 fail (from 160/59), 0 cargo-check errors; catalog and launch.json fresh; repo-lib 170/18 identical to baseline; all four surface policies 0 breaches against the live filesystem. NOT done and stated plainly: the browser end-to-end was attempted and is BLOCKED (semio-s-plugin-stdio does not compile to wasm because of the live FULL-STDIO peer ticket, and cad's schema is glued into that crate), so read-only is proven by type structure and unit test rather than a live browser session; cargo check --workspace fails with 753 errors, all attributed crate-by-crate via git log --date=iso to two live peer sessions and none in this ticket's files; verify gate is blocked by a pre-existing dependency-cruiser failure; space's studio stays a non-surface (framework-owned WorkflowSnapshot) relocated to a plugin-root engine facet; assembly's surfaces are authored but unmounted pending a pre-existing schema gap; EngineCanvas's framework-to-plugin dependency was repointed but the layering inversion deserves its own ticket. Corrections to the record: 59 SDK test failures that several lanes called "pre-existing debt" were this ticket's own canonical-id fallout (53 fixed by building ids through surface_app_id rather than literals, and one had been masking a real kind-discipline dispatch bug, now fixed); semanticCollections was deliberately not extended with the surface dirs, which would have created 286 phantom collection roots; the SemanticMutation bound on PluginBuilder::editor/viewer was never required by the surface traits and was silently blocking 32 stdio subsets from registering, now an opt-in roster capability. Full detail in the ticket folder's final-summary.md, 43 lane and audit reports, and raw gate logs.</summary>
